notes.title: Dark Maidens Now Free To Play!
notes.content: Dark Maidens being our first game here at our little indie studio, it was a tough and also a very thrilling game to create. We are happy to announce that Dark Maidens is now free to play! We hope you will enjoy playing our game!

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content: * Social Media Button Added to Main Menu and Loading Screen.

notes.title: Dark Maidens Will Become Free To Play December 17th 2022!
notes.content: After working for over year on Dark Maidens, we at ArchWitch Games have put a lot of love into our game. Truth be told, game development is very difficult and we had to learn everything by doing it as we made Dark Maidens from scratch, creating all the art, animation, sound, story, music, and code. The game may not be perfect and certainly our inexperience in finding and fostering a community, the genre of the game, and our overall inexperience contributed to this. Nevertheless, we love making games and we want to show it. So we are happy to announce that Dark Maidens will become Free To Play December 17th of 2022. We would be very happy if you played Dark Maidens, so please look forward to it!
